name: GrowthBook JS SDK
solves: Provides the GrowthBook TypeScript/JavaScript SDK (`@growthbook/growthbook`) for feature flags and A/B testing against GrowthBook's open-source, self-hostable experimentation platform.
best_for: Product teams that want feature flags plus experimentation/statistics in one open-source stack
Organizations that need to self-host flag evaluation for cost or data-residency reasons
React/Next.js apps using GrowthBook's hooks and typed feature definitions
Teams graduating from DIY toggles who are not ready for LaunchDarkly pricing
Data-informed rollouts that combine flags with experiment analysis
skip_when: You need a vendor-neutral SDK layer first — start with OpenFeature and plug providers
You only need analytics-tied flags and already standardized on PostHog
You want the lightest possible boolean toggle without an experimentation platform
Enterprise support/SLA requirements point to LaunchDarkly or Statsig
Your primary runtime is unsupported by the JS SDK and you need another language first

hosted_alternative.name: GrowthBook Cloud
hosted_alternative.pricing_summary: Open-source self-host free; GrowthBook Cloud has a free tier and paid seats/usage plans
